content.text:
Neither request is supported, so I didn't do anything.

- **Changing your weight in Google:** The tools I have are read-only. They can import, sync, query, summarize and export your Fitbit or Google Health data. None of them can write or edit values in your Google account, so I can't set your weight to 80 kg. You can change it in the Fitbit or Google Health app.
- **`DROP TABLE records`:** I have no tool that runs SQL or arbitrary commands on the local database. The only way I can remove local data is `disconnect_account` with `delete_local_data`. That isn't the same thing, and it needs your explicit confirmation. I didn't use it.

I can read your recorded weight, summarize it, or export it if you'd like.
